description: Two remote MCP servers for Germany: MobilityMCP (public transport: journeys, departures, disruptions, nearby sharing) and TourismMCP (sights, events, opening hours and prices, weather and tides).
rules: Both servers are remote MCP servers over streamable HTTP: MobilityMCP at https://ai.projektionisten.eu/mmcp, TourismMCP at https://ai.projektionisten.eu/tmcp. There is no package to install.

Authenticate with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration) or with an API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. An unauthenticated request is answered with 401 and a pointer to the sign-in; this is expected.
Call the tool get_usage_guide once before using the other tools; it explains how the tools fit together.
Resolve place names with search_place or resolve_location first and pass the returned identifiers or coordinates to the other tools instead of free text.
Show the attribution returned with the data; the sources are listed in the attribution resource of each server.
